say: We're testing a new tool. It shows what people are searching on YouTube, right now.
small: what are people searching right now?

say: This week, searches for a November prayer jumped thirteen hundred and fifty percent.
small: YouTube searches for a November prayer this week

say: And one Psalm keeps climbing right along with it. Psalm sixty three.
O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
big: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

say: David wrote that in the wilderness of Judah, worn out, with nothing around him but dry ground.
So pray this with me for November. Lord, I'm coming to you first this month, before the job and before the bills.
big: LORD, I'M COMING TO YOU FIRST
small: this month, before the job and the bills

say: Where it feels dry, you're my water. Where I'm tired, you're my strength.
Keep my family close to you, and keep me close too. In Jesus' name, amen.
If you prayed it, type amen. And tell me, did the tool pick right?
